tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs su lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dri yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa// me tog dkar gsum mchod byas te// dri dang 'bras chan ka ra zho// sbrang rtsi mngar ldan shar sgor sbyin// tshom bu'am thig le nyi shu rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya ste/ mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rnams gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha nyi shu rtsa gsum du bskyed la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te// rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya// pa gdugs dang ni pad+ma sbrel// ro tsa na dang ka ro brkyang*// dkar po bkug nas 'dren pa ni// lha dang lha mi grub pa dgug /oṃ ba ta lī ma hā ba ta lī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ a/ rgyu ba mo dang rgyu chen mo// de bzhin yi dwags rgyu ba mo// nyi ma zla ba dngos grub sbyin// rta rgyal mo dang zla rgyal mo// lha mo u ma gaṅgā mo// gzugs mdzes skar ma 'dus pa dang*// gza' tshogs kun dang tshogs kyi gtso// kārti kā dang dpal lha mo// lha mo ri bong can 'dzin ma// a ga la dang ut+pa la// lha min lha yi rgyal po rnams// sbos mo dang ni sbos chen mo// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dngos grub don du zhugs su gsol// oṃ hūm̐ he ho ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ sa ma ya dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// rgyu ba mo la dbul bar bgyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ba ta lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o// de nas sngar gyi phyag rgya las/ sdigs mdzub bkrol nas se gol brdab cing*/ gtor ma dbul bar bsams nas/ oṃ bak+ṣa ya bak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhā dzaḥdz+rum̐ hūm̐ phrum̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo// de bzhin du rgyu ba chen mo la dbul bar bgyi zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba ta lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ yi dwags rgyu ba mo la dbul// oṃ pre ta ba ta lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nyi ma la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sūr+yā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ zla ba la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ tsan+d+rā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ dngos sgrub sbyin la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sid+dha dāt+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rta rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ a shwa rā dz+nyī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ zla rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sau ma rā dz+nyī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ u ma la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ u ma de wī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gaṅgā'i lha mo nyid la dbul// oṃ gaṅgā de w+yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs mdzes ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su rū bī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ skar ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ tā rā yai saṃ ghā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gza' yi tshogs la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ gra ha na saṃ ghā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/

tshogs kyi gtso bo nyid la dbul// oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ kārti kā la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ kārti kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ dpal ldan ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha mo ri bong can la dbul// oṃ sha shī de byai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ a ga lā la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ a ga lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nye ba'i a ga lā la dbul// oṃ u pā ga lā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha yi gtso bo rnams la dbul// oṃ su ra rādz+nyī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha min gtso bo rnams la dbul// oṃ a su ra rādz+nyī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ sbos mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ puk+ka sī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nye ba'i sbos mo nyid la dbul/ oṃ u pa puk+ka sī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ de ltar mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub blang bar bya ba'i phyir du sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ bā ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ pre ta ba ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ sūr+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sid+dha dāt+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ a shwa rādz+nyī ye swā hā/ oṃ sau ma rādz+nyī swā hā/ oṃ u ma de byai swā hā/ oṃ gaṃ gā de byai swā hā/ oṃ su rū s+yai swā hā/ oṃ tā rā saṃ ghā ya swā hā/ oṃ gra ha na saṃ ghā ya swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ kārti kā yai swā hā/

oṃ shri yai swā hā/ oṃ sha shī de wī ye swā hā/ oṃ a ga lā ya swā hā/ oṃ u pa a ga lā ya swā hā/ oṃ su ra rādz+nyai swā hā/ oṃ a su ra rādz+nye swā hā/ oṃ puk+ka sī ye swā hā/ oṃ u pa puk+ka sī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la yang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o// slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ ba ta lī ye gats+tsha/ zhes kun la sbyar la gshegs su gsol lo// rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par btang ngo*// yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan drangs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyi spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya zhes bya ba'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis phul nas/ phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol lo// rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol ba'i mthar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o// shar phyogs su bya ba lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
